description: This file defines an abstract class 'FilterFormatFormBase' in the Drupal CMS, providing a base form for configuring filter formats, including role permissions, filter settings, and order.

classes.name: FilterFormatFormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base form for editing filter formats in Drupal, handling form building, validation, and submission.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Builds the configuration form for a filter format, including role permissions and filter settings.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a filter format with the given ID already exists.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates the form input, ensuring unique format names and proper trimming.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Saves the filter format configuration and updates role permissions.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Defines form actions, customizing the submit button label.
